tagline: A quiet stay in the heart of the city

early_check_in.notes: Subject to availability. Guests may request early check-in at the front desk; a fee may apply if the room is ready before 11:00 AM the same day.

late_check_out.notes: Late check-out until 2:00 PM can be requested at the front desk, subject to availability and a possible fee. After 2:00 PM, a half-day rate applies.

swimming_pool.details: Outdoor heated pool on the 3rd floor terrace, open 6:00 AM - 10:00 PM daily. Towels provided poolside.

gym.details: 24-hour fitness center on the 2nd floor with cardio machines and free weights.

spa.details: Spa services available by appointment, 9:00 AM - 8:00 PM. Contact the front desk to book.

wifi.details: Free high-speed WiFi throughout the hotel, including guest rooms and public areas.

parking.details: On-site self-parking is $18/night. Valet parking is $28/night. EV charging stations available.

restaurant.details: The Harbor Room serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner daily, 6:30 AM - 10:30 PM.

bar.details: Lakeside Lounge open daily 4:00 PM - 12:00 AM, serving cocktails and light bites.

business_center.details: 24-hour business center with printing, scanning, and two meeting rooms available for reservation.

airport_shuttle.details: Complimentary shuttle to City Airport, running every 30 minutes from 5:00 AM - 11:00 PM. Request pickup at the front desk.

pet_policy.details: Pets under 25 lbs are welcome for a one-time fee of $50 per stay. Maximum 2 pets per room. Please inform the hotel in advance.

breakfast.notes: Guests booked in Standard Queen rooms can add breakfast at booking or at check-in for $22/person/day.

policies.cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before check-in. Cancellations within 48 hours of check-in are charged one night's stay. No-shows are charged the full reservation amount.
policies.payment_policy: A valid credit card is required at check-in for incidentals. Full payment is charged at check-in unless booked through a prepaid rate.
policies.children_policy: Children under 12 stay free when using existing bedding. Cribs are available on request at no charge, subject to availability.
policies.smoking_policy: The hotel is 100% non-smoking. A $250 cleaning fee applies if evidence of smoking is found in a room.
policies.id_requirement: A valid government-issued photo ID and the credit card used for booking are required at check-in.

room_types.name: Standard Queen Room
room_types.description: A cozy room ideal for solo travelers or couples.

room_types.name: Deluxe King Room
room_types.description: A spacious room with a king bed and lake views, breakfast included.

room_types.name: Twin Room
room_types.description: Two twin beds, well suited for friends or colleagues traveling together.

room_types.name: Family Suite
room_types.description: A two-area suite that comfortably fits families of up to four adults, breakfast included. Best fit for three guests.

room_types.name: Executive Suite
room_types.description: Our top-tier room with access to the executive lounge, breakfast included.

faqs.question: Is parking available?
faqs.answer: Yes. Self-parking is $18/night and valet parking is $28/night. EV charging is available.

faqs.question: Do you allow pets?
faqs.answer: Yes, pets under 25 lbs are welcome for a one-time fee of $50 per stay, up to 2 pets per room.

faqs.question: Is there an airport shuttle?
faqs.answer: Yes, a complimentary shuttle runs to City Airport every 30 minutes from 5:00 AM to 11:00 PM.

faqs.question: What is the minimum age to check in?
faqs.answer: Guests must be at least 18 years old to check in without a parent or guardian present.
